heading: Short title.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Evidence Act, 1872, 1 of 1872 (Rep., Act 47 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 3 of 1951, s. 3 and the Schedule, for “except Part B States” (w.e.f. 1-4-1951).
The words “except the State of Jammu and Kashmir” omitted by Act 34 of 2019, s. 95 and the Fifth Schedule (w.e.f. 31-10- 2019).
Ins. by Act 18 of 1919, s. 2 and the First Schedule (w.e.f. 17-9-1919) .
Ins. by Act 35 of 1934, s. 2 and the Schedule (w.e.f 8-9-1934).
The words “that Act as modified by” Omitted by the A.O. 1950.
Ins. by Act 10 of 1927, s. 2 and the First Schedule (w.e.f 4-4-1927).

notes: As to practice relating to affidavits, See the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Act 5 of 1908), s. 30 (c) and the First Schedule, Order XIX. See also the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Act 2 of 1974), ss. 295 and 297.
